description: Enters or corrects data of a draft order: facts about the building, the heating, and the consumption periods as printed on the bills, in the bill's unit (kWh; m3 of gas, with the bill's Brennwert and Zustandszahl; litres of oil; kg of pellets; we convert). The consumption is always the whole building's, also when the customer owns one flat: from a Heizkostenabrechnung take the Gesamtverbrauch der Liegenschaft, never the customer's own share. Send only what you know: fields left out stay as they are, and consumption.periods replaces all periods. Synonyms such as 'Gas' or 'heat pump' are accepted. Values are marked as entered by an assistant; the customer sees and confirms them before ordering. Returns the order as it is now and the open points. Orders nothing.

periods.description: the billing periods of the whole building, one per period on the bill; from a Heizkostenabrechnung the Gesamtverbrauch der Liegenschaft, never one flat's share; replaces all periods

calorific_value.description: gas billed in m3 only: the Abrechnungsbrennwert (Hs) in kWh/m3 as printed; send it together with condition_factor

carrier.description: energy carrier billed, e.g. erdgas, heizoel, fernwaerme, holzpellets, strom_waermepumpe

condition_factor.description: gas billed in m3 only: the Zustandszahl as printed; send it together with calorific_value

end.description: last day of the billing period (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD

evidence.description: the text you read this period from on the bill, verbatim, for the Energieberater

hot_water_kwh.description: only if the bill states the energy for hot water separately, in kWh

kwh_is_gross.description: for kWh of gas: true if the bill states kWh by the Brennwert (gas bills usually do; default true for gas)

quantity.description: consumption for heating and hot water in the period, as printed on the bill, as a plain number: German bills group thousands with a point, so 18.451 kWh is 18451

start.description: first day of the billing period, YYYY-MM-DD

unit.description: unit as printed: kWh, MWh, m3, l, kg, t, rm (Raummeter) or srm

vacancy_percent.description: share of the living area that stood empty in the periods, in percent

attic.description: beheizt (lived in, heated), unbeheizt (unheated loft) or keins (none, e.g. flat roof)

living_area_m2.description: Wohnfläche of the whole building in m², all flats together

modernised.description: envelope parts renewed since construction: dach, aussenwand, fenster, kellerdecke; replaces the list

ownership.description: gebaeude if the customer owns the whole building, wohnung if one flat in it; the certificate always covers the whole building

purpose.description: verkauf (sale), vermietung (letting), verlaengerung (lease extension) or aushang (display or own records)

residential_only.description: true if the building is used for housing only

storeys.description: full storeys (Vollgeschosse), without attic and basement

units.description: number of flats in the whole building

carrier.description: main energy carrier of the heating: erdgas, fluessiggas, heizoel, fernwaerme, holzpellets, scheitholz, hackschnitzel, strom_waermepumpe, strom_direkt, steinkohle or braunkohle

cooled_area_m2.description: living area cooled by air conditioning, in m²

cooling.description: keine, or strom for electric air conditioning

district_heating.description: with Fernwärme: how it is generated

generation.description: how the heat is made, as the supplier states: kwk_gas, kwk_kohle, kwk_erneuerbar (combined heat and power) or heizwerk_gas, heizwerk_kohle, heizwerk_erneuerbar (heating plant)

primary_factor.description: the Primärenergiefaktor the supplier publishes, if known

supplier.description: the Fernwärme supplier, e.g. Stadtwerke Münster

hot_water.description: zentral_enthalten (made by the heating, in its consumption, share unknown), zentral_gemessen (made by the heating, and the bill states the hot water share: send it as hot_water_kwh with each period) or dezentral (electric boilers or instantaneous heaters, not in the consumption)

hot_water_by.description: with hot_water zentral_enthalten and periods of several carriers: the carrier whose system heats the water, or gemeinsam when several heat it together (e.g. a wood stove with a water jacket and a heat pump on one tank). A room stove without a water jacket heats no water. Leave it out if unknown: the hot water is then split by consumption

renewables.description: solarthermie, photovoltaik, biomasse (wood stove); replaces the list. A heat pump or wood heating counts on its own

ventilation.description: fenster (windows), anlage (ventilation system) or anlage_wrg (with heat recovery)

year.description: Baujahr of the boiler or heat pump (with Fernwärme: of the transfer station), from the type plate or the chimney sweep's record

order_token.description: the order_token start_order returned; it opens only this order, keep it private

name: update_order

hints.description: what looks odd without blocking, in German; check the values with the user

customer_can_add.description: true if the customer can add it on our page after the confirmation email

field.description: what to send, as the tools name it

sources.description: where each value came from: assistent (you), 3d (3D model), schaetzung (estimate), amtlich (cadastre), angabe (the customer)

generation.description: how the heat is made, as the supplier states: kwk_gas, kwk_kohle, kwk_erneuerbar (combined heat and power) or heizwerk_gas, heizwerk_kohle, heizwerk_erneuerbar (heating plant)

primary_factor.description: the Primärenergiefaktor the supplier publishes, if known

supplier.description: the Fernwärme supplier, e.g. Stadtwerke Münster

title: Enter order data
